title: VANDERER: Map-Free Exploration using Future-Aware and Visual-Curiosity-Guided Diffusion Policy
abstract: arXiv:2606.14879v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mobile agents require efficient exploration strategies to map unseen environments and autonomously plan tasks. Traditional methods rely on generating occupancy maps and optimizing the sequence in which unexplored regions are visited. However, beyond requiring additional sensor suites for reliable pose and depth estimation, occupancy map-based exploration policies often neglect environmental traversability constraints. To address these limitations, we propose VANDERER, an exploration framework that leverages a Visual Curiosity Module (VCM) to guide pre-trained diffusion policies using only monocular image data. This curiosity module predicts the outcomes of proposed actions via a navigation world model and evaluates them through a curiosity cost. translated_title: VANDERER：基于未来感知与视觉好奇心引导扩散策略的无地图探索
translated_abstract: 移动智能体需要高效的探索策略来对未知环境进行建图并自主规划任务。传统方法依赖于生成占据地图并优化访问未探索区域的顺序。然而，除了需要额外的传感器套件来实现可靠的位姿和深度估计外，基于占据地图的探索策略往往忽略了环境的可通行性约束。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了VANDERER，这是一个利用视觉好奇心模块（VCM）仅通过单目图像数据来引导预训练扩散策略的探索框架。该好奇心模块通过导航世界模型预测所提出动作的结果，并通过好奇心代价对其进行评估。该代价随后引导扩散过程生成能够最大化探索效果的动作。在多种模拟环境中进行评估，VANDERER超越了已有的基线方法。
tldr: 提出了VANDERER探索框架，利用视觉好奇心模块仅凭单目图像引导预训练扩散策略，无需占据地图和额外传感器即可实现考虑环境可通行性的高效探索。
en_tdlr: VANDERER is a map-free exploration framework that uses a Visual Curiosity Module with only monocular images to guide pre-trained diffusion policies toward maximally exploratory actions while respecting environmental traversability constraints.
